leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a retry function that accepts an async operation and maximum retry attempts
Implement exponential backoff logic using setTimeout and increasing delay intervals
Configure the retry mechanism to handle promise rejections and resolve upon success
Integrate error handling to differentiate between retryable failures and fatal errors
Manipulate delay calculations using a base multiplier and exponential factor
Control retry flow with conditional logic that stops after maximum attempts
Initialize and test the retry function with simulated API calls and network failures
